info.name: Sariee Cart Bug Report (aurealis)
info.description:
For aurealis.sariee.shop.

THREE server-side failures on api.sariee.com that all appear to share ONE root cause: a recently-shipped 'cart bundles' feature that is incomplete on the backend. The storefront request format is correct (register/login/avail-methods all return 200; checkout worked previously — order a23783c8 was created earlier). These are backend errors (MySQL + an undefined PHP method), not client-payload problems.

BUG 1 — Updating the quantity of an item already in the cart.
  POST /api/frontend/cart/add-update with a barcode that is ALREADY in the cart returns HTTP 500:
    {"status":false,"internal_code":500,"code":500,"message":"Something Went Wrong","data":null}
  The FIRST add of a barcode works (200). Only changing the quantity of an existing line fails.

BUG 2 — Reading a cart that has items.
  POST /api/frontend/cart/init on a NON-EMPTY cart returns HTTP 406 with a raw SQL error, e.g.:
    SQLSTATE[42S02]: Base table or view not found: 1146 Table 'sariee.cart_bundle_selections' doesn't exist
      (select * from `cart_bundle_selections` where `cart_item_id` in (...) and `deleted_at` is null)
    ...and sometimes: SQLSTATE[42S22]: Column not found: 1054 Unknown column 'cart_bundle_selections.deleted_at'.
  init on an EMPTY cart works (200).

BUG 3 — Checkout (placing an order) on a cart with items.
  POST /api/frontend/checkout/checkout-action returns HTTP 500:
    {"status":false,"message":"Call to undefined method Modules\\Frontend\\App\\Models\\CartItem::isBundle()"}
  This blocks ALL orders — no customer can check out. avail-methods (read) still returns 200.

COMMON ROOT CAUSE: the code queries a `cart_bundle_selections` table that doesn't exist and calls a `CartItem::isBundle()` method that isn't defined. Looks like a missing migration + missing model method from the cart-bundles feature.

HOW TO USE: Run the requests top to bottom (or 'Run collection'). Step C1 auto-fills the barcode id and mints a FRESH cart token for the run. Screenshot the responses of C4 (BUG 1), C5 (BUG 2) and C6 (BUG 3).

Net effect: the storefront cart works only for the first add of each product; quantities can't be changed, a non-empty cart can't be re-read, and NO order can be placed — all from the same broken cart-bundles code.
